title: Vinh in a day
summary: The square, the citadel gate, the Xô viết museum, Núi Quyết, Chợ Vinh, and the sand at Cửa Lò. No page prints a time on site. The minutes below are not a published duration. The beach distances stay 16 km, 17 km, 18 km, and about 20 km. Fees and hours are check on arrival.

stops.name: Ho Chi Minh Square
stops.note: The statue and the open square. No page prints a duration. Check on arrival.

stops.name: Vinh Citadel
stops.note: The gate and the yard. The 2025 news page puts this yard nearly 2 km from the square. Minutes were not printed. Check on arrival.

approach.note: Nearly 2 km from the square on the 2025 news page. The minutes were not printed. Check on arrival.

stops.name: Nghe Tinh Soviet Museum
stops.note: In the citadel yard. No visit time was printed. Check on arrival.

stops.name: Quyet Mountain
stops.note: The temple, then the view. Kilometres from the square were not printed. Check on arrival.

stops.name: Vinh Market
stops.note: The morning hall and the foam coffee. Market hours were not printed. Check on arrival.

stops.name: Cua Lo beach
stops.note: The sand. Keep 16 km, 17 km, 18 km, and about 20 km. About 30 minutes by car is only the Núi Cấm figure on the national beach page. A time on the sand was not printed. Check on arrival.

approach.note: 18 km and about 30 minutes by the Núi Cấm road on the national beach page. The city portal prints 17 km, a 2012 page prints 16 km, and a 2025 page prints about 20 km. Those three do not print minutes.

seoTitle: Vinh in a day — square, gate, mountain, sand
seoDescription: One day in Vinh: the square, the citadel, the Xô viết museum, Núi Quyết, Chợ Vinh, and Cửa Lò. No page prints a time on site. Distances to the beach disagree.
